protocol.speaker: USER
protocol.selection: Highest mean top5 over three domains and prefixes 0,1,2 among candidates with positive mean gain, no per-domain/prefix loss over 1 percentage point, and all dev p95 below 20 ms. Tie: lower weight. If none qualify, evaluate the highest-mean candidate as diagnostic only. Never promote automatically.

selection_proxy.definition: Optimistic offline rank-sensitive proxy: each typed grapheme costs one selection; accept costs rank+1 among five slots; choose cheapest completion after >=2 graphemes, or type word fully. Excludes spaces, scan navigation/timing, errors and cognitive effort; not measured AAC switch savings.
